label: ISO 9001:2015 Quality management systems — requirements
notice: Clause numbers and titles are used for mapping only. Summaries are Continuum's own wording, not ISO text. Verify against your licensed copy of the standard.

obligations.title: Understanding the organization and its context
obligations.summary: Know the internal and external issues that shape what the quality system must achieve, and keep that view current.

obligations.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
obligations.summary: Identify who has a stake in quality and which of their requirements matter, and review them over time.

obligations.title: Determining the scope of the quality management system
obligations.summary: State clearly which sites, products and services the quality system covers, and justify anything left out.

obligations.title: Quality management system and its processes
obligations.summary: Define each process with an owner, inputs, outputs, sequence, resources, risks and measures, and keep them working together.

obligations.title: Leadership and commitment
obligations.summary: Top management is visibly accountable for the quality system and for keeping customers at the centre.

obligations.title: Policy
obligations.summary: Maintain a quality policy that fits the organization's purpose, is communicated and is understood.

obligations.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
obligations.summary: Assign and communicate who is responsible and has authority for each part of the quality system.

obligations.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
obligations.summary: Plan how risks and opportunities affecting quality will be handled, and check the actions work.

obligations.title: Quality objectives and planning to achieve them
obligations.summary: Set measurable quality objectives and plan who does what, by when, to reach them.

obligations.title: Planning of changes
obligations.summary: Change the quality system in a planned way, considering consequences, resources and responsibilities.

obligations.title: Resources
obligations.summary: Provide the people, infrastructure, environment, measuring resources and knowledge the processes need.

obligations.title: Competence
obligations.summary: Make sure people doing work that affects quality are competent, and keep evidence of it.

obligations.title: Awareness
obligations.summary: People know the policy, relevant objectives, their contribution and the consequences of not conforming.

obligations.title: Communication
obligations.summary: Decide what is communicated about the quality system, to whom, when and how.

obligations.title: Documented information
obligations.summary: Create, approve, version, distribute, protect and retain the documents and records the system needs.

obligations.title: Operational planning and control
obligations.summary: Plan and control the processes that deliver products and services, with criteria and records.

obligations.title: Requirements for products and services
obligations.summary: Determine, review and communicate customer and other requirements before committing to deliver.

obligations.title: Design and development of products and services
obligations.summary: Run design work through planned stages with inputs, controls, outputs and managed changes.

obligations.title: Control of externally provided processes, products and services
obligations.summary: Select, evaluate and control suppliers and outsourced work that affect quality.

obligations.title: Production and service provision
obligations.summary: Deliver under controlled conditions, with traceability, care of property, preservation and post-delivery activities.

obligations.title: Release of products and services
obligations.summary: Verify requirements are met before release, and record who authorized it.

obligations.title: Control of nonconforming outputs
obligations.summary: Identify and control outputs that do not conform so they are not used or delivered unintentionally.

obligations.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
obligations.summary: Decide what to measure, including customer satisfaction, and analyse results to judge performance.

obligations.title: Internal audit
obligations.summary: Audit the quality system at planned intervals against criteria, and act on findings.

obligations.title: Management review
obligations.summary: Top management reviews the system at planned intervals with defined inputs and records decisions.

obligations.title: Improvement — general
obligations.summary: Pick and act on opportunities to improve products, services and the quality system.

obligations.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
obligations.summary: React to nonconformities, find root causes, correct them and confirm the fix worked.

obligations.title: Continual improvement
obligations.summary: Keep improving how suitable, adequate and effective the quality system is.
